conversation.text: How much is the maintenance plan?

According to the Comfort Club overview (membership/comfort_club_overview.md), the Comfort Club Standard plan is $189 per year per system, or $16.99 per month, and each additional system at the same address is $99 per year.
Comfort Club Plus is $269 per year per system.
Monthly plans require a 12-month minimum commitment.

Standard includes two seasonal tune-ups per year (one cooling, one heating), priority scheduling, the $89 diagnostic fee waived on service calls, 15% off all repairs, no after-hours dispatch fee on emergency calls, annual reminder and filter-change notifications, and $500 off any full system replacement.
Plus adds an annual water heater flush and inspection, an annual whole-home plumbing inspection, and 15% off plumbing repairs.
I thought it was $149?
The documents don't show a $149 price for the maintenance plan.
The 2026 Fee Schedule (pricing/2026_fee_schedule.pdf) lists Comfort Club at $189 per year for one system and $269 per year for Comfort Club Plus.
Comfort Club is $16.99 per month, and monthly isn't offered for Plus.

The only $149 in the documents is the after-hours emergency dispatch fee, which the 2026 Repair Price Book (pricing/repair_price_book_2026.csv) and the Customer FAQ (faq/customer_faq.md) list for non-members and which is waived for members.
A single seasonal tune-up without a membership is $129 per system, and it's included twice a year for Comfort Club and Comfort Club Plus members.
Hm. Okay.

The prices haven't changed from what I gave you: according to the Comfort Club overview (membership/comfort_club_overview.md), Comfort Club Standard is $189 per year per system or $16.99 per month, and Comfort Club Plus is $269 per year per system.
Existing members keep their enrollment price until their next renewal date, when the current price applies.
If you have questions about the plans or want to compare Standard and Plus, I can go over them with you.
No, that's it. Thanks.
Thanks for contacting Meridian Home Comfort. Have a great day.

conversation.text: I need to file a warranty claim. The unit you installed last year stopped working.
To file a warranty claim, call to schedule a warranty diagnostic.
If the failure is covered, there is no diagnostic fee, but if the technician determines it is not covered, the standard $89 diagnostic fee applies (Warranty Policy, Filing a claim).
Since your unit was installed last year, it is within the 2-year labor warranty that Meridian provides on all full system installations.
Comfort Club members at the time of installation receive a 5-year labor warranty instead (Warranty Policy, New system installation warranty).
Manufacturer parts warranties are separate and vary by brand.

Meridian registers every installed unit with the manufacturer within 30 days of install, and registration is required for the full parts warranty term (Warranty Policy, New system installation warranty).
Manufacturer warranties cover the part only, and labor to replace a warranted part is billable after the Meridian labor warranty expires (Warranty Policy, Manufacturer parts warranty).
